title: Patroni-orchestrated leader switchover
description: Triggers a controlled Patroni switchover (current leader -> pg-replica-1) via patronictl + verifies the new leader is elected, etcd DCS reflects the change, and HAProxy re-routes :5432 traffic to the new leader. Closes one of the four Phase 0.G.4 demo gates.

prerequisites.smokeGate: smoke-0.G.4.ps1 ALL GREEN (1 Leader + 2 Streaming Replica + etcd quorum + VIP bound on 1 haproxy)

observe.what: JSON array of 3 members; one with Role=Leader (record this as $OLD_LEADER)
Switchover summary: old leader, new leader, elapsed time (~5-10 s under lab load)
demote -> promote chain on the 2 affected nodes; PG fast-shutdown + pg_rewind sequence
JSON array; Member=pg-replica-1 now has Role=Leader; previous leader is Role=Replica
etcd DCS confirms pg-replica-1 as canonical leader

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.67 'STATS_PWD=$(sudo cat /etc/nexus-haproxy/haproxy-stats-password); curl -sS -u nexusops:$STATS_PWD http://127.0.0.1:8404/stats\;csv | awk -F, "\$1==\"pg_pool\" && \$2==\"pg-replica-1\" {print \$2,\$18}"' && ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.68 'STATS_PWD=$(sudo cat /etc/nexus-haproxy/haproxy-stats-password); curl -sS -u nexusops:$STATS_PWD http://127.0.0.1:8404/stats\;csv | awk -F, "\$1==\"pg_pool\" && \$2==\"pg-replica-1\" {print \$2,\$18}"'

observe.what: BOTH haproxy nodes' pg_pool row for pg-replica-1 == UP (each haproxy independently health-probes Patroni REST /leader and arrives at the same answer; identical haproxy.cfg)

whatProves: Patroni's etcd-DCS-driven leader election flips the writer role to pg-replica-1 within ~10 s; HAProxy's GET /leader health probe (inter 2s, fall 3, rise 2) detects the change and re-routes :5432 backend traffic without app config change. End-to-end: app-facing TCP endpoint stays stable while the underlying PG primary changes.
